stages.reference: Create an understated study of the subtle detail inside an old light-blue stained-glass sheet. The matching glass already establishes an airy powder-blue translucent body; here only nearly invisible hand-cooling waves, sparse tiny bubbles and mild worn matte variations are needed. Let each imperfection fade into pale blue depth rather than appear as a sharp white line or independent image. Keep enough transparent openness to remain recognizably glass and leave unused portions of the source detail layer unfilled. Avoid blue ice, printed clouds, bright electric glow, decorative leading, heavy frost, geometric shards, harsh reflective streaks or a solid background. The detail should quietly support the same softened mineral tint and natural optical behavior as the companion glass.
